notes.title: The update is here!
notes.notes:
Our Major Fire Commander update is now live! 

[previewyoutube=MrYq1xU12nI;full][/previewyoutube]

This update includes:

Major AI improvements
Pathfinding changes (for both firefighters and vehicles)
Balancing adjustments and optimisations 
Minor and major bug fixes

The bug fixes include key fixes such as:

Fire damage no longer stops before reaching 100%
All fires can now be extinguished
Fire no longer spreads through walls
Doors can no longer be broken through walls
Firefighters no longer refuse to extinguish certain fires

And other minor tweaks and changes.

Update your game for free and experience Fire Commander in an improved way!

notes.title: Changelog pt. 1
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes!

It’s been a busy one week since the premiere. You’ve spoken and we’re patching! Here’s a list of fixes already implemented in the game:

Fixed mission descriptions in the Fire Station
Fixed the game save while escorting an unconscious victim
Added support for AZERTY keyboard
Fixed achievements
Fixed hitboxes of incident reports on the map
Special action in the Shopping Mall mission has been changed from helicopter to airplane
Missions Railway and Railway2 now have different descriptions in the Dispatch Room
Parachute units no longer disappear after the game is loaded

More is coming so stay tuned!
